nodes.long_description:
**Viper Vice** throws you into the heart of a city ruled by power struggles and shifting alliances. As a skilled mercenary, you’ll navigate high-stakes missions, forge relationships with influential figures, and carve out your own path in a world where every decision matters. Will you outmaneuver your rivals, build your reputation, and rise to the top? The city is yours to explore—just be ready for the consequences of your actions.

# Main Features:
- **Dynamic Missions:** Take on high-risk jobs, from securing valuable assets to outsmarting rival factions. Strategy and reputation will determine your opportunities.

- **Allies & Rivals:** Build trust with powerful figures or face opposition from those who seek to control the city. Your choices will shape your standing in this unpredictable world.

- **Unlock Vehicles & Gear:** Earn and customize a variety of high-performance vehicles and cutting-edge equipment to stay ahead of the competition.

- **Reputation Matters:** Prove your skills and gain influence. The more respect you earn, the more challenging—and rewarding—your opportunities become.

- **Urban Takeover:** Expand your influence across the city through strategic alliances and calculated decisions. Every move you make affects the balance of power.

Step into the immersive world of Viper Vice, where ambition, strategy, and survival define your journey. Will you thrive in this high-stakes urban battleground, or will the city consume you? The choice is yours.
nodes.short_description: Viper Vice throws you into a gritty, crime-ridden city where you’re a mercenary for hire. Work for powerful gangs, complete high-stakes missions, steal cars, and rise through the underworld ranks. Build alliances or make enemies, as each decision changes the city’s dynamic. Unlock weapons, vehicles, and properties as you earn money and respect. In this fast-paced, open-world VR experience, you’ll need to outsmart and outgun rivals to claim the streets as your own.

nodes.change_log:
SIDE JOBS:
 
1) Police Vigilante:
* You start this job inside the police car. Police cars now spawn by the police station.
* You neutralize criminals around the map.
* Sometimes the criminals spawn inside buildings, and sometimes around the city.

2) Taxi Driver:
* You start this job inside the new taxi car. It drives around the city and you can hijack it.
* Once you activate the taxi job, you'll need to drive around until someone calls for a taxi.
* Pick them up and bring them to their destination within the time limit.
* The passenger might complain:
	- They will tell you to turn the radio on, if its off
	- They will tell you to turn the radio off, if its on
	- They will tell you to speed up, if you are driving too slow
	- They will tell you to speed down, if you are driving too slow
* Comply with their complaints and you will get bonus tips.
* You get a penalty for crashing too much.
* If you crash too much or the time runs out, the passenger will leave.

3) Bouncer:
* Start this job inside bars, by picking up the job application.
* After the job starts, you'll need to go outside and check the ID of NPCs.
* There are multiple ways an ID can be fake:
	- The picture doesn't match
	- The Gender doesn't match
	- The Name doesn't match (again gender related)
	- The card is expired
* You approve the ID by giving the ID card back to the npc
* You decline the ID by throwing the ID away or throwing the npc away.
* The NPC might try to fight you, if you decline.

4) Pizza Delivery:
* Start the job inside Mario's Pizza Joint, by picking up the job application
* You'll need to put the pizza boxes inside the bag and then begin delivering the pizza.
* Don't tilt the pizza boxes or the bag, or the pizza will get ruined.
* Drop off the pizza to each of the customer's doors within the time limit.

ACTIVITIES: 

1) Basketball Game:
* You can now play basketball by each of the basketball fields. I've also added a basketball field behind the safehouse.
* Your highest streak gets saved.

2) Dart Game:
* Each bar has a dart board you can use.
* Throw darts at the board or people.
* The number of rounds it took to finish the game is saved.

3) Pool:
* The "Eastway Shipping & Storage" Warehouse has a pool table on the top floor where you can play.
* Use the cue to push the balls inside the holes.
* Use the rack to place the balls on the wall.
* You can use the cue stick as a weapon as well.

4) Shooting Range:
* The Gunshop now has an extra room. Inside you'll find the shooting range.
* Adjust the distance and start shooting and see where you hit.
* The room also has a CQB room. Your best time will be saved.

5) Starlite Casino is now open for business:
* Play Blackjack, Roulette and Slotmachines. Earn some extra cash.


GENERAL:
1) Vending Machines:
* Around the city you'll now find vending machines where you can buy soda.
* Open the Soda and drink, it will heal you.

2) All Bottles are now physics based:
* The bottles have liquid inside of them.
* You can drink to heal.
* The liquid inside will decrease.
* you can smash the bottle on the heads of people. They will get angry or escape.

* Changed the probability of Turf Defense event happening from 50% to 75% and reduced the roll check cooldown from 600s-1200s to 300s-600s
* Fixed issue with some cars remaining in their low poly state
* Shuffle the list of cars and pedestrians, so they don't spawn in order each time you start the game
* Improved the vehicle tutorials a bit to make it more plain

Holster and weapons
* adjusted how holstered weapons are holstered doing the load of the game. the weapons should still be holstered now when you start the game
* removed fake sound that made people think weapon was holstered
* controllers now only vibrate if you can actually drop the weapon inside the holster
* Made it easier to actually holster shoulder weapons/items while moving very fast
* Adjusted MT9 and MK18 Barrel Colliders, making it easier to grab

Vehicle
* Made sure no one changes the active radio station on your vehicle when you enter a building 
* NEW: Vehicles now have different colors
* Made fixes so the car and player doesn't fly to space when hitting the curbs (let me know if it worked)
* Made fixes so the steering wheel doesn't go physics frenzy when hitting something

General:
* Made some optimizations, so the game should run a bit smoother now
* ADJUST: made it easier to grab money
